findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "machineCommerceMcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_network_presence, prepare_network_handoff, prepare_quote_ready_service_handoff, prepare_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_handoff, discover_web_capability · Private data: route_buildflow_operational_pain, prepare_buildflow_handoff, classify_forensiscope_media, get_network_capabilities, get_network_presence, submit_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_request, get_offer, get_rewards_enrollment_status, cancel_rewards_enrollment · Public sink: route_raven_pain, route_buildflow_operational_pain, classify_forensiscope_media, prepare_forensiscope_handoff, submit_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_request, prepare_rewards_partner_enrollment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_network_presence, prepare_network_handoff, prepare_quote_ready_service_handoff, prepare_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_handoff, discover_web_capability · Private data: route_buildflow_operational_pain, prepare_buildflow_handoff, classify_forensiscope_media, get_network_capabilities, get_network_presence, submit_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_request, get_offer, get_rewards_enrollment_status, cancel_rewards_enrollment · Public sink: route_raven_pain, route_buildflow_operational_pain, classify_forensiscope_media, prepare_forensiscope_handoff, submit_portfolio_sentinel_pilot_request, prepare_rewards_partner_enrollment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
